title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Recognition Standard: Relocation Compensation
content:
When a hotel relocates a reservation credited to an Ashbury Rewards membership because it cannot honour it, the member is compensated in points. This standard sets the conditions; the points of each tier are that tier's relocation compensation figure.

## Conditions in force

1. **Relocated reservation.** Compensation is posted only for a reservation whose status is relocated.
2. **Guarantee and rate plan.** When the tier's setting limits relocation compensation to guaranteed reservations, the reservation must have been guaranteed, which every reservation booked under an Ashbury rate plan is, and the rate plan must be eligible for relocation compensation.

## Retired clauses

> **No longer in force.** The clause "When a hotel relocates a reservation credited to the membership, the member receives the relocation compensation points of their tier, posted as relocation compensation with the relocated reservation's reference" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for relocation compensation.

> **No longer in force.** The clause "Compensation is posted once per relocated reservation, whatever the number of nights, and is the member's only compensation from Ashbury Rewards for the relocation; guest services adds no other goodwill points" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for relocation compensation.

## Judgement table

| Reservation status | Guaranteed | Rate plan eligible for relocation compensation | Conditions of this standard met |
|---|---|---|---|
| Relocated | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Relocated | Yes | No | No |
| Cancelled, no-show, checked out or confirmed | — | — | No |

A reservation booked under an Ashbury rate plan is always guaranteed, so for such a reservation the guarantee condition holds and the rate plan's eligibility decides.
